description: Normalize a batch of SKUs and find the ones that collide. Send skus (up to 200) and choose: case (upper, lower or keep), separators (hyphen: every run of space . _ / - becomes one hyphen; remove: they are dropped; keep: left as typed) and strip_leading_zeros (true or false). Get back each SKU's normalized form, and the collision groups: SKUs that become the same code, split into exact duplicates (typed identically) and different spellings of one code (AB-001, ab 001, AB001 under the remove option). Use it to clean a product feed or merge two catalogs before import. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/sku-normalize). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

separators.description: hyphen (default): each run of space . _ / - becomes one hyphen and leading or trailing ones go; remove: all dropped; keep: as typed.

skus.description: The SKUs to normalize, up to 200, in the order you want positions reported.

strip_leading_zeros.description: true: in each part between separators, zeros at the start of a leading run of digits are dropped, keeping one digit (007A becomes 7A, 000 becomes 0). Default false.

name: sku_normalize
title: SKU Normalize and Duplicate Check
